REPORT.description: PSC AASHTO-LRFR19 Rating Report (REPORT). Generates the PSC LRFR19 rating/design Excel report for the open project; the request fields set the export location, output file name, and image-saving option. All fields are optional and a POST with an empty body {} is valid (internal defaults applied).

Argument.description: Report generation request (PSC_EXCEL_REQUEST). All fields optional.

EXPORT_PATH.description: Export directory path (e.g. C:\Report\). Empty = project file directory.

OUTPUT_NAME.description: Output file name without extension. Empty = project file name.

SAVE_IMAGE_OPTION.description: Save image option (Rating Report only). Design Report ignores this field.
